title: Button Group
description: Buttons joined into one piece: shared edges, one radius, no gaps. For toolbars, paging and split actions.
usage: Group one size and one weight at a time — the group owns the outer radius and the shared borders, the buttons keep their own colors. A split action is a group of two: the action, then the chevron.
a11y: Plain buttons in a row; wrap the group in a labelled container (role="group" with an aria-label) when the grouping itself carries meaning, and keep the tab order left to right.
